_comment: Which enacted Act text is CURRENTLY in force, per Act family - hand-maintained fact table injected into AI Mode's synthesis prompt (and, as a single default-act anchor only, keyword expansion) so the LLM doesn't distrust a real doc just because its Act name/year looks newer than the model's own training cutoff (e.g. 'Income Tax Act 2025' read as a hallucinated/future act instead of the real, enacted replacement for the 1961 Act). synthesize.py filters this list down to only the entries whose es_act_field substring actually appears in that turn's retrieved excerpt text, so the prompt never grows with unrelated Acts. Update by hand whenever an Act supersession/edition change happens - same rationale as repotaxmannapi_boost_config.json's own top-level comment.

acts.name: Income-tax Act, 2025
acts.status: current - effective 1 April 2026, replaces the Income-tax Act, 1961

acts.name: Income-tax Act, 1961
acts.status: superseded by the Income-tax Act, 2025 from 2026-04-01; still governs periods before that date

acts.name: Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017
acts.es_act_field: Central Goods And Services Tax Act 2017
